tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// bya spyod rigs gsum spyi'i rig gtad kyi cho ga bzhugs// ༄༅// byang chub sems dpa' chen po gsung gi mnga' bdag 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur bar 'dod na/ spyi don bdun te/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid brtag pa dang*/ bsnyen pa bya ba dang*/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ sta gon du gnas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi bya ba dang*/ mjug tu bya ba'i cho ga dang*/ phan yon dang nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ slob dpon bya spyod kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing rgyud thos pa/ bla ma las lung thob pas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya ste/ de lta ma yin na nyes par 'gyur ro// slob ma'i mtshan nyid kyang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba rang gi bslab pa la gnas shing theg pa chen po la dad pa/ yang dgos su rdo rje theg pa la gus pa/ phan tshun nang gshin pa gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du zung du ma gyur pa yongs su gzung bar bya'o// gnyis pa bsnyen pa ni/ bdag bskyed dam med kyang rung ste/ lha la gsol ba gdab pa'i tshul gyis bzlas brjod 'bum phrag gcig sogs grangs ci 'grub bya'o// gsum pas cho ga ni sngar sbyang ba ma byas pa yin na/ gsang sngags zlos shing sa phyogs byug pa byas pas btub bo// sta gon du gnas pa ni/ spyi rgyud las/ rnam dpyad dang po sa gzhi gzung*// gnyis pa sta gon gnas pa ste// nub gsum pa la 'jug pa shis// zhes 'byung bas na/ nub dang po la sa chog dang*// gnyis pa la sta gon dang*/ gsum pa la dngos gzhi ste nub gsum du bya ba yin la/ sa chog mi dgos pa'i phyogs su ni nub gnyis kyis yongs su rdzogs par bya dgos pa yin mod kyi/ shin tu rings pa'i dus su ni sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis ka nyi ma gcig la phyag len mdzad pa man ngag brgyud pa las mthong mod kyi/

gzhung na mi snang ngo*// de ltar nub gsum mam gnyis su yang byed mod kyi/ sta gon du gnas pa la bzhi/ sa'i lha mo dang*/ lha dang*/ bum pa dang*/ slob ma sta gon du gnas pa'o// de la de dag gi sngon du 'gro ba ni 'di yin te/ gnas khang ba byung lngas gtsang bar byi dor byas la/ bla re dang bris sku dgram/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa bsham/ slob dpon bdag nyid khrus byas te/ gos gtsang ma bgo dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du/ slob dpon gyis gso sbyong cho ga blang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa gzung ste/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// zhes bla ma'i rjes su lan gsum bzlas so// de ltar na bya ba'i rgyud kyi lugs la ni/ slob dpon gyi bya ba de tsam yin mod kyi/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma 'jug na/ bdag nyid yid dam lha'i nga rgyal bsgoms la bzlas pa cung zhig bya ba dang*/ sngon du 'gro ba 'di dag ni 'og ma rnams la bdag lhar bsgom pa dang*/ mi bsgom pa'i lugs gnyis po 'di shes par bya'o// der dri'i thig le dang*/ me tog tshom bu byas la/ der sa'i lha mo bskyed/ mchod pas mchod/ gtor ma gtang*/ gsol ba btab la gshegs su gsol// de nas lha'i gnas su dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu byas la/ 'jam dpal lam rigs gsum ka bskyed/ ye shes pa dgug de la me tog la sogs pa mchod pa lngas mchod la/ bstod pa bya ba ni/ sku gsung thugs 'jam 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal// gzhon nu'i tshul mdzes yon tan brgyan pa'i sku// de phyir 'jam dpal gzhon nur mtshan gsol ba// blo gros bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes sku// 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal// gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na// gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi bdag po ste// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod la/

sta gon gyi lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon sgrub grogs dang bcas pas/ lag pa g.yas su spos bzung*/ g.yon gyi dril bu dkrol zhing*/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ dbyangs med kyang rung ste/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje mchog /bcom ldan spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal// bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje mgon// rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod// dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// mgon po bdag ni bri bar 'tshal// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir// bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa lags// de bas bka' drin mdzad par 'os// 'gro ba 'khor lo'i don mdzad pa'i// sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol// 'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*// gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*// gang su rdo rje'i spyan can rnams// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni// rigs gsum zhes bya'i dkyil 'khor 'di// 'gro ba dag phyir bdag 'dri bas// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// thugs rje thugs dpag mdzad nas kyang*// dkyil 'khor par bcas thams cad kyi// thugs rjes dgongs te nye bar mdzod// ces lan gsum brjod do// lha sta gon du gnas pa'o// de nas bum pa sta gon du gnas pa ni/ bum pa legs par bca'/ bcud gzhug stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las rin po che'i bum par bskyed/ bum pa'i mgrin par khro bo'i rigs la nyi ma/ zhi ba'i rigs la zla ba la rang rang gi rig sngags bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdud rtsi bum pa'i nang du spyan drangs la/ bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ gsang sngags bzlas te/ bum pa sta gon du gnas pa'o// skabs 'dir dpung pa bzang po nas 'byung ba bzhin gdon gyi gtor ma dang*/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma gnyis gtong ngo*// de nas slob ma gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar kha yar ba rnams khrus byas nas maṇḍal byas te gral du 'khod pa rnams la sdig pa bshags pa dang*/

bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ yongs su bsngo ba ste/ yan lag bdun pa byas te/ slob dpon gyi rjes su slob mas lad mo bya/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces brjod do// nub gnyis par byed na so shing dang*/ srung skud dang*/ skyor chu dang*/ rmi lam brtag pa rnams byas la/ gang ltar yang chos zab mo bshad la spro ba bskyed de/ lha la dngos grub kyi don du gsol ba gdab/ gong gi bstod pas bstod/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes pa gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces brjod la/ yi ge brgya pa brjod la ye shes pa badzra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dngos gzhi'i nyin bar/ ngag tu oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags zlos shing thig gdab pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor rtsig pa ser po rim pa gcig pa'i gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'am/ yang na padma 'dab brgyad tsam la brten kyang rung ste/ gang ltar yang dbus ser/ shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ de'i lte bar zla ba'i dbus su ral gri dang padma dang rdo rje bya/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis tshon gyis bri ba dang*/

'jam dpal la sogs pa'i mtshan ma dgod pa dang*/ mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya chen po bshams la/ lha bskyed pa'i dang*/ mi bskyed pa'i bdag gi bya ba sngon du song nas/ dkyil 'khor du lha rnams bskyed cing spyan drang ba dang*/ mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi drung du sgrub pa'i grogs gzhan bzhag ste/ rdo rje slob dpon phyi rol du byung ste/ dpung bzang dang mthun pa'i gtor ma gnyis phyogs thams cad du btang la/ phyi rol du bdug spos kyis bdag nyid bdugs te nang du zhugs nas dkyil 'khor la mchod par bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi rtsa ba'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa dang*/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhiḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐/ 'khor rnams la bdun bdun tsam bzlas la/ yang ci 'byor pa'i mchod pas dkyil 'khor mchod la/ 'og tu slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba'i dbang rnams rdo rje slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las dbang dang dam tshig nod par bya'o// de nas shes rab snying po la sogs pa mdo cung zhig bton la ci 'byor pa'i dkyil 'khor la mchod par bya'o// spyir du yang dkyil 'khor la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/ rtag tu gu gul dkar po dang spang spos kyis bdugs/ spos rgyun mi 'chad par gtul bar bya'o// slob dpon 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas slob ma yol ba'i phyi rol du bos la/ las kun byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi chu gtor la/ yang sngags de nyid kyis gdong dar dmar pos bcings la/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa sta gon bzhin du bya/ de nas yol ba'i nang du bkug la/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes pa gtso bo'i sngags zlos shing*/ bla ma'i phyag slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// dri med kun gyis mthong bar shog

/ces bden pa'i stobs brjod la/ dkyil 'khor du me tog dor ba de blangs la slob ma'i spyi bor bcing*/ de nas slob mas me tog snyim par thogs pas/ bla ma las a ra pa tsa na la sogs pa'i gsang sngags kyi lung lan gsum blangs la/ las kun byed pa'i sngags a mṛ ta zlos shing*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba la sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pa dang*/ glu dbyangs dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bum pa'i chus slob ma'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam mo// chu de khong du'ang lan gsum 'thung du gzhug ste/ de'i dus su 'jam dpal gyi shes rab dang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje dang*/ phyag na rdo rje'i mthu stobs kyi/ dngos grub gsum the tshom med par rang la byung bar bsams la/ de'i dus su gsang sngags zlos shing*/ 'og tu ku sha'i stan byin pa dang*/ lus la gu gul dkar po'i bdug pas bdugs pa dang*/ mgo'i steng du gdugs gzung bar bya'o// bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te bya ba'i rgyud kyi'o// //de'i steng du spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur byed par 'dod pas/ yi dam lha'i sngags zlos shing*/ dbu rgyan spyi bor bcings nas/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal tshab thob par bsgom pa dang*/ yid dam lha'i gsang sngags zlos shing*/ rdo rje dril bu nas kyi 'bras tshad tsam srin lag gi 'og tu sbas te byin la gsang ba'i dbang bskur thob par bsgom mo// dbu rgyan dang phyag mtshan gnyis ni/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi lhag po yin no// lhag ma rnams ni 'dra'o// de nas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba bya zhing*/

dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la gsol ba gdab par bya'o// slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis ka'i thun mong gi dbang ngo*// de la snying rje dang ldan pa rdo rje slob dpon byed par spro ba rnams la chu'i dbang ldabs la bskur/ phyag rgya bcings bas gsang sngags zlos shing spyi bor gtugs/ gdugs dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la dngos su mi btub na/ yid kyis bskor ba lan gsum byas nas phyag byas te/ bla mas slob ma'i spyi bo nas bzung ste dkyil 'khor la dbul/ lag pa nas bzung ste rjes su gnang bar bya/ dpung pa bzang po la sogs pa'i rgyud tshar gcig klog tu gzhug de ma grub na rig sngags cung zad zlos su gzhug go /slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga'o// //de nas gnyis ka la thun mong du dgos pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa dpog par bya ste/ slob ma rnams legs par gral byas pa la ma yengs par gyis shig ces brjod la/ gsang ba spyi rgyud dang*/ legs par grub pa nas 'byung ba bzhin/ dam tshig rnams ngag tu brjod la/ de ltar srungs shig bya ba dang*/ dngos grub rnams 'di ltar sgrubs shig rgyud la sogs pa sems can gzhan rnams la 'di ltar shod cig bya ba tho tsam brjod par bya'o// de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba rnams bstan zin to// //spyi don drug pa mjug tu bya ba'i cho ga rnams ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams legs par mchod pa dang*/ grub na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba dang*/ gtor ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phyag byas nas bzod par gsol te/ spos chu'i zhabs bsil phul la gshegs su gsol bar bya'o// rdul tshon dman pa chu bor dor la/ dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad dman pa rnams dkon mchog mchod pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid longs spyad pa dang*/ phongs pa rnams la sbyin par bya'o// //spyi don bdun pa dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba la sogs pas cho ga byas na nyes pa du ma skyed cing*/

dkyil 'khor mthong bas cho ga byas na dngos grub tu ma 'byung la/ dang po sngags dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ dkyil 'khor bslabs pa'i rjes la rgyud sbyin par bya'o// slob mas kyang dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams la dga' ston dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon la yon gyis mnyes par byas la/ las kyi rjes bsdu bar bya'o// //bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur gyi cho ga gsang ba spyi rgyud la brten pa'i lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/ bla ma kha che ye shes rdo rje'i man ngag bla ma lo chung grags mchog shes rab kyis/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la gnang ba'i gsal byed 'di ni/ dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon par/ shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis cing nge ston pa 'dul ba 'dzin pas lan mang du gsol ba btab nas/ zhal gdams yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
